name: VictoriaMetrics
author: VictoriaMetrics
description: VictoriaMetrics is a fast, cost-effective and scalable monitoring solution and time-series database. It is a drop-in replacement for Prometheus remote storage, supports PromQL/MetricsQL, the Prometheus and InfluxDB ingestion protocols, and runs as a single small binary.

form_fields.label: Retention period
form_fields.hint: How long to keep data, e.g. 12 (months), 1y, 30d.
